// GIVEN. The conversation on level 2. Do not edit. Yours is my/dialogue.txt, and it uses the same format.

NAME Sage
BOSS Warden
QUEST gold
START 0 2 3 6

LINE 0
SAY I am building a shield, and I am 3 gold short.
A I will find it. -> 1
B Not my problem. -> -1

LINE 1
SAY Monsters carry gold. Come back with 3.
NEXT -1
GIVES start quest

LINE 2
SAY You do not have 3 gold yet.
NEXT -1

LINE 3
SAY You have the gold! Will you trade it?
A Here you go. -> 4
B I will keep it. -> -1

LINE 4
SAY Done. Give me a moment.
NEXT 5
GIVES finish quest

LINE 5
SAY There. It will take a hit for you.
NEXT -1
GIVES give shield

LINE 6
SAY The shield is holding up, I hope?
NEXT -1
